ModMetaData.name: Futa Ideo Stuff
ModMetaData.author: toasterbath
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a Futanari Supremacy ideology meme for RimWorld 1.6.
Futanari are the ultimate form and should rule above all others.
The meme is mutually exclusive with Male Supremacy and Female Supremacy.
While a believer's ideology contains this meme, only futanari may hold any ideology role - including the vanilla leader role. Futanari additionally receive a mood boost and inspire positive social opinion.
Also adds the "Ascended" role, an optional futanari rank of recognition granting improved social impact and work speed.
Requires Ideology and RimJobWorld.
